4.2 Refund Timing and Method

Refunds are issued within 5 business days after the RPC records a passed inspection. Refunds always go back to the original payment method. Card refunds can take an additional 3 to 10 business days to appear on the customer's statement, depending on the card issuer. Orders paid with a gift card or store credit are refunded as store credit, which is available immediately.

4.3 Shipping Charges

Original shipping charges are refunded only for reason codes DF-02, WI-03, DT-04 and MP-05. Return shipping is always free when the customer uses the prepaid label from OMS.

4.3.1 Expired or Closed Cards

If the original card has expired or been closed, the refund is still sent to that card; card issuers forward the credit to the replacement card or to the account. If the issuer rejects the refund, OMS converts it to store credit automatically and the agent should offer to reissue it by check, which takes up to 10 business days.

4.3.2 Partial Returns From Bundles

Items bought as a bundle (for example the T3 with one Room Sensor S1, SKU LT-T3-02) can be returned individually. The refund for each item is its share of the bundle price in proportion to the list prices, not the full list price of the item.

3. Confirm eligibility against section 2. If the return window has passed, check whether the product is still under warranty and follow LHS-SOP-TS-007 instead.

4. For a defective return, complete the troubleshooting steps for the product in the relevant product guide and record them in the LumoraDesk ticket.

5. Select the return reason code (Table 3-1) and create an RMA of type RET in OMS as described in the RMA Process SOP.

6. Confirm the refund amount, any restocking fee and how the refund will be paid. Read the amounts back to the customer.

7. Send the prepaid return label from OMS. The label is emailed within 1 business day and is valid for 14 days.

8. Link the RMA number to the LumoraDesk ticket and set the ticket to Pending - Return in Transit.

4.1 Refund Approval Thresholds

4.5 Returnless Refunds

If the item price is $40.00 or less and the customer reports a defect that troubleshooting confirms, the agent may issue a refund or free replacement without requiring the item to be returned. Returnless refunds are limited to one per customer per 12 months and do not require Team Lead approval. The Room Sensor S1 single pack is the most common case.

5. Exceptions

• Late returns: a Team Lead may approve a return up to 15 days after the window has closed, once per customer. Note the reason in the ticket.

• Chargebacks: if the customer has opened a card dispute, do not process a refund. Route the ticket to the Finance Disputes queue.

• Repeat returners: customers with three or more returns in 12 months are flagged in OMS. Refunds for flagged customers need Team Lead approval regardless of amount.

• Price adjustments within 14 days of purchase follow the price match rules in the Billing FAQ and are not processed as returns.

6. Quality and Records

Every return must have an RMA number linked to a LumoraDesk ticket. Quality Assurance audits 5% of refunds each month. Audit findings are reviewed with the agent's Team Lead within 10 business days.

Purpose. Defines how Customer Care handles return requests and refunds for products bought directly from Lumora (online store and phone orders), from eligibility checks to refund approval. 2.1 Return Window

Customers may return any product bought directly from Lumora within 30 calendar days of the delivery date, for any reason. The return is considered on time if the RMA is created within the window; the customer then has 14 days to ship the item.

2.3 Non-Returnable Items

2.4 Restocking Fee

A 15% restocking fee applies to opened change-of-mind returns when the RMA is created more than 14 days after delivery. Purpose. Reference for supporting the Lumora Thermostat T2 (model LT-T2), covering specifications, installation, configuration, troubleshooting and error codes. Use this guide together with the Ticket Escalation SOP when a case cannot be resolved at first contact.

1. Product Overview

The Lumora Thermostat T2 is the entry model of the Lumora climate line. It replaces a standard low-voltage wall thermostat and adds scheduling, remote control through the Lumora Home app and monthly energy reports. The T2 is designed for single-zone homes with conventional furnaces, boilers and single-stage heat pumps.

The T2 is sold under SKU LT-T2-01 at a list price of $149.00. It is positioned below the Lumora Thermostat T3, which adds a color touchscreen, a humidity sensor, multi-stage heat pump support and battery-backed operation. Agents should take care not to mix up the two models: several limits, error codes and the warranty term are different.

1.1 What Is in the Box

• Thermostat T2 display unit and wall plate

• Optional trim plate for covering marks left by older thermostats

• Two wall screws, two drywall anchors and a sheet of wire labels

• Quick Start card with the pairing code (also printed on the back of the unit)

1.2 System Compatibility

The T2 works with 24 VAC low-voltage systems only. It is compatible with gas, oil and electric furnaces, hot-water and steam boilers, central air conditioning and single-stage heat pumps without auxiliary heat.

The T2 requires a C-wire (24 VAC common) for continuous power. If the home has no C-wire, the Lumora Power Extender Kit PEK-1 must be installed at the equipment control board. The T2 has no internal battery and cannot run on power-stealing.

3. Installation

Installation takes 30 to 45 minutes for most homes. Customers may install the T2 themselves. Customer Care may offer professional installation through the Lumora Certified Installer network for a flat fee of $129.

3.1 Before You Start

1. Switch off power to the heating and cooling equipment at the circuit breaker or service switch. Confirm the system is off by raising the setpoint on the old thermostat and waiting two minutes; the equipment must not start.

2. Remove the faceplate of the existing thermostat and take a clear photo of the wiring before disconnecting anything. Installers must attach this photo to the installation record.

3. Label each wire with the supplied wire labels according to the terminal letter it was connected to, not by wire color. Wire colors are not standardized between installers.

4. Disconnect the wires and remove the old wall plate. Wrap the wire bundle around a pencil so that it cannot fall back into the wall.

3.2 Wiring Terminals

Terminal | Function | Typical wire color
R / Rh | 24 VAC power (heating transformer) | Red
Rc | 24 VAC power (cooling transformer); jumper to R if only one | Red
C | 24 VAC common - required for the T2 | Blue or black
W1 | Heat stage 1 | White
W2 | Heat stage 2 | Brown or white
Y1 | Cool stage 1 / compressor | Yellow
G | Fan | Green
O/B | Heat pump reversing valve | Orange or dark blue

Table 3-1. T2 wall plate terminals.

3.3 Mounting and Wiring

1. Hold the T2 wall plate against the wall with the bubble level at the top, mark the two screw holes and drill 3/16 in holes if anchors are needed.

2. Feed the wires through the center opening and screw the wall plate to the wall.

3. Insert each labelled wire into the matching terminal until the terminal button clicks. Strip wires to 1/4 in if the copper end is damaged.

4. Push excess wire back into the wall and snap the display onto the wall plate.

5. Restore power at the breaker. The T2 starts within 60 seconds and shows the setup screen.

Safety: If the device itself shows signs of damage such as a cracked display or exposed electronics, tell the customer not to install or power it.

Q10. Part of my order is missing.

Large orders may ship in more than one package; check the shipping confirmation emails first. If an item is missing from a package that has arrived, the agent checks the package weight recorded by the warehouse in OMS. If the recorded weight matches a complete shipment, the case is escalated to the warehouse for review within 2 business days before a replacement is sent.

4. Holidays and Installation Appointments

Q11. What are the holiday shipping cutoffs?

Lumora publishes the exact cutoff dates on the website each November. As a rule, standard orders must be placed by December 15 and expedited orders by December 20 to arrive before December 25. Overnight orders placed by 1:00 PM Eastern on December 23 arrive on December 24. The warehouse is closed on Thanksgiving Day, December 25 and January 1.

Q12. How are installation appointments scheduled?

When an order includes professional installation, the customer receives a scheduling link by email after the order ships. Appointments are available Monday to Saturday in 3-hour arrival windows. Customers can reschedule without charge up to 24 hours before the appointment; a missed appointment without notice incurs a $49 fee deducted from the installation refund.

Q13. What packaging does Lumora use?

Orders ship in recyclable cardboard with paper padding. Lumora does not use plastic air pillows or foam. Several items in one order may be packed together in one box to reduce waste, even when they appear as separate lines on the invoice.

5. Business and Bulk Orders

• Orders of 25 or more units ship by freight and require a delivery appointment.

• Business accounts receive standard shipping free on all orders.

• Freight deliveries must be inspected on arrival and damage noted on the delivery receipt; otherwise damage claims cannot be accepted.

Purpose. Defines ticket priorities, service level targets and the rules for escalating tickets between support tiers, to management and to the Safety Officer.

1. Support Tiers

Tier / team | Responsibility
Tier 1 - Customer Care | First contact for all channels: orders, returns, billing, basic setup and troubleshooting.
Tier 2 - Technical Support | Advanced troubleshooting, wiring questions, warranty claims, installer support.

Escalations Desk | Complaints involving executives, media, social media or regulators.
Safety Officer | Owner of all safety cases (fire, smoke, burns, electrical shock, swollen batteries).

2. Priority Levels and SLAs

Every ticket is assigned a priority when it is created. The priority can be raised at any time but may only be lowered by a Team Lead. SLA clocks for P1 run 24 hours a day; all other priorities use business hours (Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM Eastern).

Priority | Definition | First response | Customer updates | Resolution target
P1 - Critical | Safety hazard, or no heat when indoor temperature is below 50 °F | 15 minutes | Every 2 hours | 4 hours
P2 - High | System cannot be controlled at all, or an issue affects multiple customers | 1 hour | Every business day | 1 business day
P3 - Normal | Single device fault with a workaround | 4 business hours | Every 2 business days | 3 business days

The incident owner posts a status update for agents every 4 hours until the incident is resolved, and Customer Care Operations decides within 2 hours whether a banner message is shown in the app.

4. Safety Escalations

Any report of smoke, fire, a burning smell, scorch marks, melted terminals, electrical shock or a swollen battery is a safety case. Safety cases are always P1, regardless of the product or the customer's request.

1. Instruct the customer to switch off power to the HVAC system at the circuit breaker. If there is smoke or fire, tell the customer to leave the building and call emergency services, and end troubleshooting.

2. Create or update the ticket as P1 with the category Safety.

3. Notify the Safety Officer through the safety hotline queue within 1 hour of the first report, at any time of day.

4. Ask the customer to keep the device and not to discard it. Do not request photos while there is any ongoing hazard.

5. The Safety Officer informs Tier 3 Product Engineering and Legal within 24 hours and owns all further customer communication.

Important: Agents must never suggest that a safety case was caused by the customer, and must not offer compensation. Compensation for safety cases is decided only by the Safety Officer.

5. Management Escalations

• Customer asks for a supervisor: create a callback task for a Team Lead. The Team Lead must call back within 4 business hours.

• Social media, press or regulator mentions: route to the Escalations Desk the same business day. Agents do not respond publicly.

• Executive complaints (emails addressed to company officers): handled only by the Escalations Desk, first response within 1 business day.

6. Goodwill Credits

Goodwill credits compensate customers for poor experiences, such as missed callbacks or repeated contacts. They are issued as store credit and do not replace refunds owed under the Returns and Refunds SOP.

7.1 Handoff Summary

Every escalation must include a summary with these fields:

• Customer name, account email and device serial numbers

• Problem statement in one sentence and when it started

• Troubleshooting already done, with results

• Customer expectation and any commitments made

• Priority and SLA deadline

7.2 Warm Transfers

P1 and P2 escalations by phone must be warm transfers: the agent stays on the line and introduces the case to the receiving agent. If no agent is available within 5 minutes, the ticket is escalated in LumoraDesk and the customer is told when to expect a callback.

7.3 Closing Escalated Tickets

Escalated tickets may only be closed after the customer confirms the issue is resolved, or after three contact attempts over 5 business days without a reply. The closing note must state which of these applied.

Purpose. Defines how Return Merchandise Authorizations (RMAs) are created, how returned units are received, inspected and graded at the Returns Processing Center (RPC), and how RMAs are closed.

1. RMA Types

Type | Used for | Created by | Outcome after inspection
RET | Returns for refund within the return window | Tier 1 | Refund per LHS-SOP-CC-004
WAR | Warranty claims - standard replacement | Tier 2 | Replacement ships
ADV | Warranty claims - advance replacement | Tier 2 | Card hold released
DOA | Device dead on arrival, reported within 14 days of delivery | Tier 1 or Tier 2 | Replacement ships by expedited shipping at no cost

Table 1-1. RMA types.

2. RMA Numbers and Validity

RMA numbers use the format RMA-YYMM-NNNNN, where YYMM is the year and month of creation and NNNNN is a sequence number, for example RMA-2603-00417. An RMA is valid for 30 days from creation. The customer must ship the item within 14 days; RMAs with no carrier scan after 14 days receive an automatic reminder email, and RMAs still open after 30 days are cancelled automatically.

Only one RMA may be open per serial number. If a customer needs to change the RMA type (for example from RET to WAR), cancel the open RMA and create a new one rather than editing the type.

3. Creating an RMA

1. Open the order or the device record in OMS and select Create RMA.

2. Choose the RMA type from Table 1-1 and the reason code from the Returns and Refunds SOP or the warranty claim.

3. Enter the serial number of every unit being returned. OMS rejects serial numbers that do not belong to the order or account.

4. Select the return method: prepaid label (default), carrier pickup (bulk RMAs only) or battery return kit (see section 7).

5. Add the LumoraDesk ticket number and save. OMS emails the RMA number and packing instructions to the customer.

3.1 Bulk RMAs

RMAs for 10 or more units on one account, typically from installers or property managers, require approval from the Operations Manager before the RMA is released. Bulk RMAs ship by freight pickup on a pallet, scheduled by the RPC within 3 business days of approval.

4. Receiving at the RPC

1. Scan the RMA number on the package label. Packages must be logged in OMS within 1 business day of arrival at the RPC.

2. Open the package and compare the serial number on each unit with the serial numbers on the RMA.

3. Inspect and grade each unit within 3 business days of arrival (section 5).

4. Record the grade and disposition in OMS. This triggers the outcome in Table 1-1 automatically within 1 business day.

4.1 Exceptions at Receiving

Exception | Handling
Serial number does not match the RMA | Place the unit on hold and ask Customer Care to contact the customer. If the discrepancy is not resolved within 5 business days, process the RMA as not received and return the unit to the customer.
Package arrives without an RMA number | Move to the quarantine shelf for 10 business days while Customer Care tries to identify the sender. Unidentified units are then scrapped and recorded as unclaimed.
Wrong product received | Hold the item and contact the customer; the RMA stays open until the correct item arrives or the RMA expires.
Visible battery swelling or leak | Stop handling. Move the package to the hazardous materials cabinet and notify the RPC supervisor immediately.

Table 4-1. Receiving exceptions.

5. Inspection and Grading

Inspectors power on every unit on the test bench, confirm it connects to the test network, run the automated self-test and check for physical damage, liquid indicators and missing parts. Each unit receives one grade:

Grade | Criteria | Disposition
A | Unopened, or opened with all parts and no signs of use | RTS - return to stock as new
B | Opened, complete, passes self-test, minor signs of use | RFB - refurbish and sell as Certified Refurbished
C | Missing parts or cosmetic damage, passes self-test | RFB, or harvest for parts if refurbishing is not economical
D | Fails self-test, physical or liquid damage | SCR - scrap and recycle; RTV - return to vendor if defect rate tracking applies

Table 5-1. Inspection grades and dispositions.

Units returned under a WAR or ADV RMA that fail the self-test are recorded as confirmed defects. Units that pass the self-test with no fault found are graded normally, and the result is added to the warranty claim record.

6. Closing an RMA

• RET: the refund is released in OMS within 1 business day of the inspection result; Customer Care confirms the amount to the customer.

• WAR: the replacement is picked, packed and shipped within 2 business days of receipt.

• ADV: the card authorization hold is released; if the unit is not received within 21 days of the replacement delivery the card is charged.

• DOA: the replacement ships by expedited shipping the same business day when the RMA is created before 12:00 PM Eastern, without waiting for the return.

7. Returning Devices With Batteries

The Thermostat T3 contains a lithium-ion battery. A T3 that is reported with a swollen, hot or leaking battery must not be shipped with a standard prepaid label. Instead, select the return method Battery Return Kit when creating the RMA. The RPC sends kit BRK-1, a fire-resistant pouch with a hazardous-materials label, by ground shipping within 2 business days, and the customer must not return the device until the kit arrives. Undamaged T3 units and all other products ship normally.

8. Performance Targets

Metric | Target
Dock to logged in OMS | 1 business day
Dock to inspected and graded | 3 business days
Dock to stock (Grade A) | 5 business days
RMAs open longer than 30 days | 0 (auto-cancelled)

Table 8-1. RPC performance targets.

The RPC supervisor reviews the targets weekly with Returns Operations. Grade D rates above 8% for any product in a calendar month are reported to Product Engineering as a possible quality issue.

Role | Responsibilities
Customer Care (Tier 1) | Creates RET and DOA RMAs, sends labels, answers customer questions about RMA status.
Technical Support (Tier 2) | Creates WAR and ADV RMAs after an approved warranty claim; manages card holds for ADV.

RPC inspector | Runs the test bench, grades units and records dispositions.
RPC supervisor | Hazardous materials handling, weekly target review, approval of scrap batches.
Operations Manager | Approves bulk RMAs and exceptions to this SOP.

Table 9-1. RMA roles.

9.1 Answering RMA Status Questions

Agents can see the RMA status in OMS: Created, Label Sent, In Transit, Received, Inspected, Closed or Cancelled. If a customer asks why a refund or replacement has not arrived, check the status first. Received but not inspected after 3 business days is a breach of the RPC target and should be reported to the RPC supervisor queue rather than promised to the customer as a date.

6. Return Shipping

Q14. How do I send a return back?

Every approved return or warranty RMA comes with a prepaid return label sent by email. The customer prints the label, attaches it to the box and drops the package at any location of the carrier named on the label, or schedules a free pickup from the carrier website. Customers without a printer can show the QR code from the email at a staffed carrier location.

Q15. Do I need the original box?

No. Any sturdy box works as long as the device is padded and cannot move. Customers should not tape the label over old barcodes; old labels must be removed or fully covered.

Q16. How long does a return take to reach Lumora?

Return packages usually take 3-7 business days to reach the Returns Processing Center. The customer can follow the tracking link in the RMA email. Refunds and replacements start after the RPC has received and inspected the package, as described in the Returns and Refunds SOP.

4.4 Inspection Grades and Partial Refunds

The RPC grades every returned unit using the grading scale in the RMA Process SOP. The grade determines the refund outcome for change-of-mind returns:

Grade | Condition | Refund outcome
A | Unopened or like new, complete | Full refund.
B | Opened, complete and working | Full refund, less restocking fee if section 2.4 applies.
C | Missing parts or cosmetic damage | Refund less 20% of the item price.
D | Physical or liquid damage, or not working without a defect report | Refund denied; Team Lead review. The unit is shipped back to the customer at no cost.

Table 4-2. Grade-based refund outcomes.

4.5 Returnless Refunds

If the item price is $40.00 or less and the customer reports a defect that troubleshooting confirms, the agent may issue a refund or free replacement without requiring the item to be returned. Returnless refunds are limited to one per customer per 12 months and do not require Team Lead approval. The Room Sensor S1 single pack is the most common case.

5. Exceptions

• Late returns: a Team Lead may approve a return up to 15 days after the window has closed, once per customer. Note the reason in the ticket.

• Chargebacks: if the customer has opened a card dispute, do not process a refund. Route the ticket to the Finance Disputes queue.

• Repeat returners: customers with three or more returns in 12 months are flagged in OMS. Refunds for flagged customers need Team Lead approval regardless of amount.

• Price adjustments within 14 days of purchase follow the price match rules in the Billing FAQ and are not processed as returns.

6. Quality and Records

Every return must have an RMA number linked to a LumoraDesk ticket. Quality Assurance audits 5% of refunds each month. Audit findings are reviewed with the agent's Team Lead within 10 business days.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

App and Account FAQ

Document number | LHS-FAQ-APP-005
Revision | 3.4
Effective date | April 6, 2026
Document owner | Customer Care Knowledge Team
Audience | Customer Care agents; approved answers may be shared with customers
Classification | Internal - do not distribute outside Lumora

Purpose. Approved answers to questions about the Lumora Home app, account security, household sharing, data and privacy, and app features such as Away mode and energy reports.

1. Account and Sign-In

Q1. What are the password requirements?

Passwords must be at least 10 characters long and include at least one letter and one number. Passwords used in known data breaches are rejected. The app never asks for the password by email, and agents must never ask customers for their password.

Q2. I am locked out of my account.

After 5 failed sign-in attempts the account is locked for 15 minutes. After the lock expires the customer can try again or use Forgot Password. Password reset links are valid for 1 hour. Agents cannot unlock accounts manually.

Q3. How does two-step verification work?

Two-step verification can use an authenticator app or a text message code. It is optional for most users but mandatory for the home Owner when the home has more than 3 members. If the customer loses access to their second step, they can use one of the 10 recovery codes shown at setup. Without recovery codes, identity must be verified by Tier 2 using the order history, which takes up to 2 business days.

Q4. How do I change my email address?

The email address is changed in Account > Profile. A verification link is sent to the new address and is valid for 24 hours; the change only takes effect after the link is opened. A notice is also sent to the old address.

4. Gift Cards and Store Credit

Q12. Do gift cards or store credit expire?

Lumora gift cards do not expire and have no fees. Store credit issued for refunds or goodwill credits expires 24 months after it is issued. Neither can be exchanged for cash, except where required by state law.

Q13. Can store credit pay for Lumora Plus?

Store credit and gift cards can be used for products and the first payment of an annual Lumora Plus plan. Monthly plans and renewals must be paid by card.

5. Business Accounts

Q13a. How do business accounts work?

Businesses such as installers and property managers can apply for a business account on the Lumora website. Approval takes up to 3 business days. Business accounts get volume pricing on orders of 10 or more units of the same product, free standard shipping, and optional invoicing with net-30 terms after a credit check. Invoices not paid within 30 days put new orders on hold.

Units of the same product per order | Discount from list price
10-24 | 8%
25-99 | 12%
100 or more | Quote from the business sales team

Table 5-1. Business volume pricing.

6. Billing Disputes

Q14. I see a charge I do not recognize.

Ask the customer for the date and amount of the charge and search OMS by the last four digits of the card. Charges usually match a shipped package, a Lumora Plus renewal or a missed installation appointment fee. If no matching order is found, advise the customer to contact their card issuer and record the contact in the ticket.

Q15. The customer has filed a chargeback.

Do not issue a refund or replacement while a chargeback is open. Route the ticket to the Finance Disputes queue, which responds to the card issuer within the issuer's deadline. Lumora Plus is suspended while a chargeback for a subscription payment is open.

3. App Features

Q6. How does Away mode work?

Away mode uses the location of household members' phones to detect when everyone has left. The home switches to the Away temperatures when all members with location sharing turned on are outside the geofence, and back when the first member returns. The default geofence radius is 500 m (about 0.3 mi) and can be set between 150 m and 3,000 m in Settings > Away.

Q7. When are energy reports sent?

Energy reports for the previous month are sent by email and shown in the app on the 3rd day of each month. Reports need at least 20 days of data in the month; homes set up later in the month receive their first report the following month.

Q8. Does the app work without internet?

The app needs an internet connection to control devices remotely. Homes with a Hub H1 can still be controlled from a phone on the same local network when the internet is down. Thermostats always keep running their schedules without internet.

4. Data and Privacy

Q9. How long is my data kept?

Temperature and runtime history is kept for 90 days on the free plan and for 3 years with Lumora Plus. Location data used for Away mode is processed on the phone and only the result (home or away) is sent to Lumora; it is kept for 30 days.

Q10. How do I delete my account?

The Owner can request deletion in Account > Privacy > Delete Account. Devices must be removed from the home first. The account is deactivated immediately and permanently deleted after 30 days; during those 30 days, signing in again cancels the deletion. Order and invoice records are kept for 7 years because of tax requirements, even after the account is deleted.

Q11. Can I download my data?

Yes. In Account > Privacy > Download My Data the customer can request an export of account, device and history data. The download link is emailed within 72 hours and is valid for 7 days.

Q4. Is a signature required?

A signature is required for orders with a total over $500. Customers cannot waive the signature requirement. If nobody is available, the carrier makes two more attempts and then holds the package at a local pickup location for 5 business days before returning it to Lumora.

2. Tracking and Changes

Q5. How do I track my order?

A shipping confirmation email with the tracking number is sent when each package leaves the warehouse. Tracking information can take up to 24 hours to appear in the carrier system. Orders can also be tracked in the app under Account > Orders.

Q6. Can I change the address or cancel my order?

4. Setup and Configuration

4.1 First-Time Setup

1. Choose the language and temperature unit on the thermostat.

2. Select the equipment type: conventional (furnace or boiler) or heat pump.

3. Connect the T2 to the home wireless network (2.4 GHz only). Networks that use the same name on 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz work as long as 2.4 GHz is enabled.

4. Open the Lumora Home app, tap Add Device and enter the six-digit pairing code from the Quick Start card.

5. Run the equipment test from Settings > Equipment > Test to confirm heat, cool and fan each start correctly.

4.2 Schedules and Comfort Settings

The T2 supports up to four schedule periods per day (Wake, Away, Home, Sleep) with separate weekday and weekend programs. Temporary holds last until the next schedule period; permanent holds stay in place until the customer cancels them in the app or on the device.

Auto changeover between heating and cooling requires a minimum deadband of 3 °F between the heat and cool setpoints. The T2 refuses settings that would make the deadband smaller.

4.3 Adding Room Sensors

The T2 can average its own reading with up to two Lumora Room Sensor S1 units. When a third sensor is added the app shows the message "Sensor limit reached". Customers who need more sensors should be offered the T3, which supports more sensors.

However, a C-wire or the Power Extender Kit PEK-1 is mandatory in three cases: heat pump systems that use auxiliary or emergency heat, any system with more than one cooling stage, and homes where the T3 controls a humidifier or dehumidifier through the ACC terminals. In these cases the T3 displays error E10 within 24 hours if no C-wire is detected, and Customer Care must arrange a PEK-1 before the case can be closed.

3.4 Mounting

1. Mount the wall plate 52 to 60 in (1.3 to 1.5 m) above the floor on an interior wall, away from supply vents, windows and direct sunlight.

2. Insert the labelled wires into the matching terminals and push the excess back into the wall.

3. Attach the display. The T3 starts on battery immediately and asks for the equipment configuration.

4. Restore power at the breaker and complete the setup wizard.

4. Configuration

4.1 Equipment Setup

The setup wizard detects connected terminals and proposes an equipment configuration. Installers must confirm the heat pump changeover setting (O or B), the auxiliary heat lockout temperature (default 35 °F outdoor) and the number of stages before finishing.

4.2 Humidity Control

With a humidifier or dehumidifier connected to the ACC terminals, the T3 can hold indoor humidity between 30% and 60% RH. Without accessory equipment, the T3 can still dehumidify by overcooling: it runs the air conditioner up to 3 °F below the cooling setpoint while humidity is above target.

4.3 Room Sensors and Occupancy

The T3 supports up to six Lumora Room Sensor S1 units. Each schedule period can use a different set of sensors, and the Follow Me mode averages only rooms where occupancy was detected in the last 30 minutes.

3.3 Homes Without a C-Wire

Unlike the T2, the T3 can usually be installed without a C-wire. It charges its internal battery from the heating and cooling circuits while the equipment is idle, and runs on the battery for up to about 6 hours during power interruptions. The battery-only mode is designed for single-stage conventional systems and has been validated on furnaces and boilers.

Does the T2 work during a power outage?

No. The heating and cooling equipment does not run without power either. When power returns, the T2 restarts automatically with its schedule intact.

Can two T2 thermostats be used in the same home?

Yes, one per zone. Homes with two or more thermostats need a Hub H1 so that the app can show all zones in one home.

Can the T2 lock its controls?

Yes. Settings > Lock sets a 4-digit PIN. While locked, the control ring only shows the current temperature. The PIN can be removed from the app by the home Owner or an Admin.

Why does the display dim?

The backlight dims after 30 seconds without interaction to save power. Brightness and timeout can be changed under Settings > Display.

4. Safety Escalations

Any report of smoke, fire, a burning smell, scorch marks, melted terminals, electrical shock or a swollen battery is a safety case. Safety cases are always P1, regardless of the product or the customer's request.

1. Instruct the customer to switch off power to the HVAC system at the circuit breaker. If there is smoke or fire, tell the customer to leave the building and call emergency services, and end troubleshooting.

2. Create or update the ticket as P1 with the category Safety.

3. Notify the Safety Officer through the safety hotline queue within 1 hour of the first report, at any time of day.

4. Ask the customer to keep the device and not to discard it. Do not request photos while there is any ongoing hazard.

5. The Safety Officer informs Tier 3 Product Engineering and Legal within 24 hours and owns all further customer communication.

Important: Agents must never suggest that a safety case was caused by the customer, and must not offer compensation. Compensation for safety cases is decided only by the Safety Officer.

• Customer asks for a supervisor: create a callback task for a Team Lead. The Team Lead must call back within 4 business hours.

9.2 Quick Answers

Can the T3 show outdoor temperature?

Yes. The T3 shows outdoor temperature and humidity from a weather service based on the home address. An outdoor sensor is not required.

Does the T3 work during a power outage?

The display and network connection stay on battery for about 6 hours, so the app continues to show indoor conditions. The heating and cooling equipment does not run without power.

Can the T3 screen be locked?

Yes. Settings > Lock sets a 4-digit PIN. A locked T3 still allows temperature changes within a range set by the home Owner, by default ±2 °F of the scheduled setpoint.

Table 2-1. Thermostat T3 technical specifications.

Comparison: Customers frequently compare the T2 and T3. The key differences are the setpoint range (T2: 45-90 °F, T3: 40-92 °F), room sensor support (T2: 2, T3: 6), C-wire requirement (T2: required, T3: recommended) and warranty (T2: 2 years, T3: 3 years).

However, a C-wire or the Power Extender Kit PEK-1 is mandatory in three cases: heat pump systems that use auxiliary or emergency heat, any system with more than one cooling stage, and homes where the T3 controls a humidifier or dehumidifier through the ACC terminals. In these cases the T3 displays error E10 within 24 hours if no C-wire is detected, and Customer Care must arrange a PEK-1 before the case can be closed.

3.4 Mounting

1. Mount the wall plate 52 to 60 in (1.3 to 1.5 m) above the floor on an interior wall, away from supply vents, windows and direct sunlight.

2. Insert the labelled wires into the matching terminals and push the excess back into the wall.

3. Attach the display. The T3 starts on battery immediately and asks for the equipment configuration.

4. Restore power at the breaker and complete the setup wizard.

4. Configuration

4.1 Equipment Setup

The setup wizard detects connected terminals and proposes an equipment configuration. Installers must confirm the heat pump changeover setting (O or B), the auxiliary heat lockout temperature (default 35 °F outdoor) and the number of stages before finishing.

4.2 Humidity Control

With a humidifier or dehumidifier connected to the ACC terminals, the T3 can hold indoor humidity between 30% and 60% RH. Without accessory equipment, the T3 can still dehumidify by overcooling: it runs the air conditioner up to 3 °F below the cooling setpoint while humidity is above target.

4.3 Room Sensors and Occupancy

The T3 supports up to six Lumora Room Sensor S1 units. Each schedule period can use a different set of sensors, and the Follow Me mode averages only rooms where occupancy was detected in the last 30 minutes.

7.1 Warranty Summary

The Thermostat T3 carries a 3-year (36-month) limited warranty from the date of delivery, one year longer than the T2. The warranty can be extended when the T3 is professionally installed; the conditions are defined only in the Lumora Limited Warranty Policy (LHS-POL-001). Advance replacement is available for the T3 to all customers (see the Warranty Claims SOP).

• Burning smell, scorch marks or a swollen battery: safety case, P1 in the Ticket Escalation SOP. Instruct the customer to remove the display from the wall and keep it away from flammable material.

• E1 or E4 that persists after a power-cycle: warranty claim.

• E10 after a PEK-1 has been installed: Tier 2 Technical Support.

Check the firmware version under Settings > About before troubleshooting. The current T3 release is 2.6.1. Battery status is shown under Settings > Power; a battery below 20% while the system is idle usually means the battery cannot charge without a C-wire.

Symptom | Likely cause | Resolution

Humidity reading stuck at 0% or 100% | Humidity sensing element failure | Power-cycle; if it persists the code E4 is shown - start a warranty claim.
Auxiliary heat runs too often | Aux lockout set too high or droop too small | Lower aux lockout; set aux droop to 2 °F or more.

5.1 Factory Reset

On the T3, open Settings > Reset > Factory Reset and confirm with the 4-digit code shown on screen. If the touchscreen is unusable, remove the display from the wall plate, then press the recessed reset button on the back for 10 seconds while reattaching it.

6. Error Codes

T3 error codes share some numbers with the T2 but not their meanings. In particular, network problems are reported as E12 on the T3, while E4 on the T3 refers to the humidity sensor.

Does the T2 work during a power outage?

No. The heating and cooling equipment does not run without power either. When power returns, the T2 restarts automatically with its schedule intact.

Yes, one per zone. Homes with two or more thermostats need a Hub H1 so that the app can show all zones in one home.

Can the T2 lock its controls?

Yes. Settings > Lock sets a 4-digit PIN. While locked, the control ring only shows the current temperature. The PIN can be removed from the app by the home Owner or an Admin.

Why does the display dim?

The backlight dims after 30 seconds without interaction to save power. Brightness and timeout can be changed under Settings > Display.
